
```{r echo=FALSE}
Vs30_TARGET <- 250
TR_TARGET <- 10000


CAP <-  "Horizontal seismic (pseudo-static) coefficients for all facilities in terms of peak-ground accelerations (Kh) for AEP ranging between 1/100 to 1/10,000 yr. All values were obtained assuming soil site conditions with  Vs30=%s  m/s and a maximum shear stiffness at the base of the slope of Go=%4.1f MPa (Quantile p=%s)."
```

## Seismic Coefficients for MDE - Large residual displacements

::: {.panel-tabset}
### p=mean

```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}
p_TARGET <- "mean"
Da_TARGET <- 25
TBL <- KIT[ Da==Da_TARGET &  TR==TR_TARGET & Vs30==Vs30_TARGET & p==p_TARGET]
TBL |> buildTable(library="gt",font.size.body = 12,font.size.header = 14,font.bold.header=TRUE)

```


### p=5%

```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}
p_TARGET <- 0.05
Da_TARGET <- 25

```
